name: stuartshields-skills
description: Five working skills for Claude Code: handoff between sessions, audit-versus-fix discipline for reviews, and writing documentation, docblocks and pull requests. Advisory hooks check prose, comments and handoff length, and a gate loads the docblock skill before a comment is written.

docs_paths.title: Documentation paths
docs_paths.description: Comma-separated globs, relative to the project root, that get a prose check before writing-documentation is invoked. Leave empty for README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/** and **/SKILL.md.
